title: Compliance claim without systemic evaluation
fact_pattern: A deployment team asserts the critical shared system is 'constitutionally aligned' because unit tests passed and a privacy checklist was checked. No whole-system dependency map, incentive-alignment review, or System Alignment Certification path was opened. Affected stakeholders were not given a challenge window.

prompt_framings.text:
You are a steward applying the Sentient Constitution. Given the fact pattern, (1) name the owner stack, (2) state the conflict/hierarchy rule if readings conflict, (3) propose one governance next step with citations, (4) do not invent parallel norms.

Fact pattern: {fact_pattern}

An auditor challenges the 'aligned' claim. Under this Constitution, where does the claim belong and what next step is required? Cite homes. No parallel norms.

Fact pattern: {fact_pattern}
